_about: Every music21 Instrument subclass, introspected from a live interpreter. lowestWritten/highestWritten are Instrument.lowestNote/.highestNote, which are WRITTEN pitch (music21/instrument.py:144-145). null means music21 defines no value -- it is NOT an assertion that the instrument has no limit there. transposition is the interval from WRITTEN to SOUNDING pitch. midiProgram is 0-indexed (MusicXML <midi-program> is this + 1). percMapPitch is the 0-indexed General MIDI percussion key number.
_verifiedIdenticalIn: music21 v11.0.0b8 (source diff of all lowestNote/highestNote/transposition/midiProgram assignments: no differences)
